messages:
Maria PM: Quick check-in on the new compact credentials panel prototype. Main goals: reduce clutter, keep critical actions discoverable (create/rotate/revoke), and make revoke recoverable but explicit. Uploaded a sketch. Thoughts on empty state CTA placement and the soft-revoke countdown UI?

Lee (Design): Sketch: compact list + inline expand. Plan: show a subtle countdown badge (e.g. "Revoked — 23:59:12 undo") on the row when soft-revoked. For empty state, propose CTA center-left with small explainer: 'Server keys for backend services. Rotate monthly.'

Jon (UX): Love the inline countdown. Microcopy suggestion: instead of 'Revoked' use 'Revoked (recoverable)' to reduce panic. For CTA: add secondary link 'Learn about rotation' next to button. Also propose contextual hint when a user hovers revoke: 'Revoke stops calls immediately; services will fail unless rotated.'

Sam (Eng): Backend constraints: realtime countdown per-row is expensive at scale. Suggest showing absolute revoke expiry timestamp and client-side countdown for visible rows only. Soft-revoke workflow: mark key state = 'pending_revoked' server-side; background job permanently deletes after TTL. Need decision on TTL default (24h?) and whether org admins can override.

Ada (a11y): a11y notes: ensure countdown updates don't cause screen reader spam. Use aria-live='polite' and only update the toast/row when minute changes, not every second. For the revoke confirmation dialog/panel use `role=dialog` and ensure focus lands on primary action. Provide accessible label for timer: 'Revoked, undo available for 24 hours.'

Maria PM: Product decision: default TTL = 24h soft-delete. Add org policy toggle for immediate hard revoke. Default UI: show readable expiry (e.g., 'undo available for 23h') and small 'Permanent revoke' checkbox in advanced options.

Lee (Design): Question: where to put rotate vs revoke in dense mode? Proposal: primary CTA = rotate (safer flow), secondary = revoke in a dropdown. Rotate modal in-panel with 'create replacement' checkbox pre-checked.

Jon (UX): Agree rotate should be prominent. Copy for rotate modal: Header 'Rotate key' Body 'Create a new key and update services. Old key will be revoked automatically.' Buttons: 'Rotate and keep old (soft-revoke)' vs 'Rotate and revoke old (permanent)'.

Sam (Eng): Note on secret handling: never render secrets in DOM until user requests reveal. When revealed, show for 8 seconds then mask. Emit audit log event on reveal. Also limit copy button to throttle (rate limit) to avoid accidental exfil.

Ada (a11y): Reveal behavior: set focus to revealed textbox and provide aria-describedby 'secret-visible-for-8-seconds'. Announce when it is masked again. Keyboard: pressing Escape should re-mask immediately.

Maria PM: Empty state variants: 1) fresh org (no keys) — big CTA + doc link. 2) small number of keys — show tips panel: 'Rotate monthly' + 'Use least privilege'. 3) >50 keys — default to compact density with toggle to 'Expanded view'.

Lee (Design): Visual: for soft-revoked rows use low-contrast stripe + dotted outline and an inline 'Undo' button. If user scrolls away, surface a top banner 'Keys recently revoked — recover' with CTA to manage.

Jon (UX): Telemetry: track revoke -> undo rate, revoke -> permanent toggle usage, reveal -> copy events, and undo timing. We'll use these to tune TTL and copy. Propose A/B test wording: 'Revoke will stop services immediately' vs 'Revoke will disable this key immediately' to see which is clearer.

Sam (Eng): Implementation plan: feature flag rollout, client-side countdown only for visible rows, server TTL enforcement. Also add endpoint `GET /orgs/:id/keys?include_perm_info=true&batch=xxx` to reduce chatter for permissions chips.

Ada (a11y): Final checklist request: focus order in panel, keyboard-only rotate/revoke, aria-live for toasts, announcements for secret reveal/mask, and color contrast pass for countdown badge. I'll draft test cases.

Maria PM: Next actions: Lee update mocks to include compact density + revoke countdown states. Sam to validate API + TTL. Jon to write microcopy options and A/B plan. Ada to produce accessibility test checklist. Schedule follow-up Wed AM. Thanks :white_check_mark:
